title: First-year base rent per critical IT kW in two U.S. data center leases
method: Divide reported first-year base rent by 12 and by contracted critical IT capacity in kilowatts. Convert MW to kW by multiplying by 1,000. For the phased Core42 leases, the amounts cover the first 12 months of each lease, not a common calendar period.
comparison_limits: Selected signed wholesale leases. The calculations are implied unit rents before separate charges and without time-value or delivery-risk adjustments. They are not current offers or market-wide pricing.

records.payment_basis: Take-or-pay reservation. The filing says the tenant pays operating expenses, including electricity, in addition to rent.
records.delivery_basis: The filing dated November 16 projects tenant delivery in Q1 2027 at a site described as energized.

records.case: TeraWulf La Lupa leases with Core42
records.payment_basis: The reported prepayment equals the first 12 months of base rent under each lease in aggregate and is credited against half of monthly base rent until exhausted. Do not treat the credit as a base rent discount or add the prepayment on top of the rent it offsets.
records.delivery_basis: The issuer reports the full 60 MW of contracted critical IT capacity in service as of September 30, 2026.

locators: Management’s Discussion and Analysis, La Lupa
